app.name: JARVIS Avatar
app.summary: Animated reactor avatar showing voice assistant state, with HUD and image variants for different screens.
app.entity_hint: An input_text or sensor that holds the voice assistant state.
app.variant_hint: Reactor draws with LVGL; HUD matches the View Assist dashboard; Image loads a picture.
app.url_hint: Address of a picture. Use /local/filename.gif for files in Home Assistant www, or a public URL the manifest allows.
app.fit_hint: Cover fills the tile; Contain shows the whole image.
app.no_picture: No picture support on this screen
app.tappable_hint: Tap the avatar to trigger a wake animation.
